_comment: bits manifest signer — sign-only proxy config. Copy to the host SECURITY_PROXY_CONFIG_DIR as config.json. Holds NO key: the Ed25519 seed is pushed over the ingest socket into the 'bits-sign-key' slot and kept in memory. 'cert' is a never-provisioned ingest slot: the daemon requires a credential of some kind even for a sign-only config, so this satisfies that check without putting any cert on disk (it stays 503/unused; the local sign route needs no TLS). host=0.0.0.0 binds all interfaces; the backend (Phase 3) reaches the proxy by the docker service name 'security-proxy' + the advertised port, NOT the advertised host (which is loopback for a wildcard bind).
